title: Add Direct Idea
description: The operator adds a ticket of their own as an idea on the fast lane.

ticket_file.description: Path of the operator's Markdown ticket in format C1.

feature_id.description: Optional (--to). The feature the idea joins and whose branch it uses. Absent: fleetd starts a new feature.

idempotency_key.description: Opaque key that the horch CLI makes once per command run. The command channel request and the request file of the same run carry the same key. fleetd applies a request once per key and returns the first outcome again (orchestrator, D15).
